c.name like concat('%',#{categoryName},'%')

SELECT i.*, p.`name` product_name,p.`code`,p.price,p.unit,p.min_stock, w.`name` warehouse_name,w.location,DATEDIFF(i.expiration_date,NOW()) dats_left FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN product p ON i.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w on i.warehouse_id=w.id WHERE product_id IN ( SELECT i.product_id from inventory i LEFT JOIN product p on i.product_id=p.id GROUP BY i.product_id HAVING SUM(i.quantity)<SUM(p.min_stock)/count(product_id) ) ORDER BY i.product_id

SELECT i.*, p.`name` product_name,p.`code`,p.price,p.unit, w.`name` warehouse_name,w.location,DATEDIFF(i.expiration_date,NOW()) dats_left FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN product p ON i.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w on i.warehouse_id=w.id
DATEDIFF(i.expiration_date,NOW()) < #{daysLeft}

SELECT i.product_id,p.`name`,SUM(i.quantity) total_quantity,p.price,p.`code`,p.unit, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT w.`name` SEPARATOR ',') as warehouse_name, MIN(DATEDIFF(i.expiration_date,NOW()))AS min_days_left, MIN(i.production_date) AS min_production_date, p.supplier_id ,s.name supplier_name from inventory i LEFT JOIN product p ON i.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w on i.warehouse_id=w.id LEFT JOIN supplier s on p.supplier_id=s.id GROUP BY i.product_id
